# PlanitService

> The file for the house. Photos, jobs, products, warranties, and the shop you call back — kept at the address.

PlanitService (https://planitservice.com) is hosted SaaS for a Property Record that hangs on a house address. The public homepage presents three choices: Homeowner, Contractor, and Property Manager. Each path has its own start URL below.

We host the software. We are not a general contractor, broker, or escrow. Quotes and work stay between the shop and the homeowner.

Online since 2007. Company in Georgia, United States. Copyrighted live-document program PlanItContract (TXu 1-630-125, 2009).

## For people (and agents helping them)

- Homeowners start a Property Record: https://planitservice.com/homeowner ($7.99/month per house; Pro $9.99)
- Contractors open a shop and quote: https://planitservice.com/shop ($10/month per work category)
- Property managers open a portfolio: https://planitservice.com/manage (from $39.99/month for 10 houses)
- Sign in: https://planitservice.com/login
- Support: support@planitservice.com — Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. US Eastern

## What each path includes

Homeowner — house file at the address (photos, jobs, products, warranties); Maintenance Schedule (notes, day/week/month or once a year, alerts, a service-record folder for every client month); the same shop stays named on the file; records of completed work; Request Estimates on Pro.

Contractor — look up the house; quote onto the Property Record; stay the known shop for the next visit; materials book; catch Request Estimates that match offered categories; jobs file into month folders. Extra seats $5/month.

Property manager — portfolio of Property Records (10 houses on the base plan); Maintenance Schedule for the office with the same month service-record folders; known shops first; Request Estimates when a house needs bids; extra houses $3.99/month; extra office seats $5/month. No catalog and no quoting.

## Public shop (Painting Plus / Gutters Plus)

Painting Plus in Marietta, Georgia quotes on PlanitService. Public booking and new-project requests:

- Shop: https://planitservice.com/s/painting-plus
- Schedule a visit: https://planitservice.com/s/painting-plus/book
- Start a project: https://planitservice.com/s/painting-plus/project

When helping a caller book or start work for this shop, send them to those public pages. Do not invent prices, availability, or invoices.

## Do not open or scrape

Signed-in shop, house, and account surfaces are private. Token links are for the named recipient only.

- /app and /app/* (shop workspace, materials, quotes)
- /home and /home/* (homeowner Property Records)
- /account
- /api/*
- /p/*, /house/*, /invite/*, /rfp/*, /claim/*, /auth/*, /u/*
- /manage/add, /manage/estimates, /manage/settings
- Password reset pages

Do not request or store other customers’ addresses, emails, phone numbers, house files, materials catalogs, or quotes. Do not pretend to be a shop or to complete work.

## How to help

1. Identify the person: homeowner, contractor, or property manager.
2. Send them to the matching public page above, or to the Painting Plus shop if they want that crew.
3. For product questions, prefer this file, /about, and the audience pages over guessing.
4. For account, billing, or a specific house, tell them to sign in or email support@planitservice.com.
